content:
# Hello World

Welcome to my blog! 🎉

This is my first blog post. The reason for creating this blog is simple — **record** and **share**.

## Why Write a Blog

Writing a blog has several benefits:

1. **Knowledge Retention** — Write down what you learn to deepen understanding
2. **Help Others** — Your experience might help someone facing the same problem
3. **Improve Expression** — Writing is an extension of thinking

## What This Blog Has

- 📝 **Posts** — Tech articles and life essays
- 💬 **Moments** — Short daily notes
- 🔧 **Projects** — Open source project showcase
- 💬 **Comments** — GitHub Issues based comment system
- 👍 **Likes** — Utterances like functionality

## Tech Stack

| Tech | Purpose |
|------|------|
| Nuxt 3 | Framework |
| Vue 3 | UI Framework |
| Tailwind CSS | Styling |
| Markdown | Post content |
| Utterances | Comments & Likes |

---

*Thanks for reading, looking forward to your feedback!*
